source_finding: The corpus refers to complete and developing structures but does not define a general deterministic completion validator, authoritative completion event, or provisional positive family certification rule.

candidate_completion_criteria.criterion: all required direct children structurally terminated
candidate_completion_criteria.reason: Structurally terminated is itself undefined and recursive.
Orthodox-end meaning is partly documented, but discovery/authority and a general family-completion rule are absent.
Examples and decision guidance do not define one universal completion predicate.
No protected source makes the latest bar a structural completion event.
Cardinality does not prove child completion or family.

requested_state_distinction.DEVELOPING: May be used only when a future reviewed source-specific authority establishes that the structure is still developing; not eligible for complete-family certification.
requested_state_distinction.COMPLETE: May be used only when a future reviewed source-specific completion validator establishes completion; no such general validator currently exists.
requested_state_distinction.UNRESOLVED_COMPLETION: Required whenever neither a reviewed developing nor complete determination is available.

family_certification_timing.minimum_safe_condition: COMPLETE plus every required structural rule/definition and every required genuine internal-family proof.

reason_not_recommended: A trusted contract without an approved completion producer would be dormant and would not solve the earlier terminal/base blocker.
